name: railroad-crossings-app
description: Railroad crossing lookup app with PWA and Capacitor packaging groundwork.

scripts.cap:prepare: mkdir -p www/icons && cp index.html app.js style.css manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp icons/app-icon.svg www/icons/app-icon.svg
scripts.cap:copy: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap copy
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync
